abilities.description: You can perform stunning acrobatics and practically defy gravity by using the Force to leap long distances. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.e6ed148eff82c171]{Face Danger} to jump to a higher perch, leap out of the way of a threat, or leap down to a lower spot, take +1. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.2f2ba4090b22a122]{Enter the Fray}, if you miss, you can Spend Momentum (-2) to re-roll either your action die, or both challenge dice (your choice).
When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.905205c073b09eac]{Endure Harm} from taking a fall, or from taking impact from a heavy object take +1.

You can spend all 10 of your momentum to immediately exit a deadly situation at no penalty, such as leaping out of combat or leaping out of the mouth of an erupting volcano. Assume a strong hit for this move and @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-2). If you do this, you are put into an advantageous position to escape if you wish.
